Risk:
Operational Risks – Risk of
loss arising from inadequate or
failed internal processes, people,
systems or external events.
Source of Risk:
Sources of risk include.
• Conduct
• Legal & regulatory
• People
• Processes
• Information technology, including cyber
• Brand and reputation
Mitigation:
• We have applied enhanced business standards cover-
ing all processes within JHL.
• We have embraced business continuity planning,
cybersecurity measures, and compliance frameworks
to safeguard operations against internal and external
threats.
• Proactive engagement with regulators and adherence to
evolving legal requirements protect JHL from penalties
and reputational damage.

Risk:
Asset Management Risks
- Risks arising from products,
investment decisions, trade imple-
mentation, asset allocation and
post trade analysis/monitoring.
Source of Risk:
Sources of risk include:
• Funds’ Performance and margin
• Fund liquidity
• Products risks
• Retention or withdrawal risks
• Compliance
Risks related to asset management are generally main-
tained at low level as is commercially possible.
Mitigation:
• Robust product development processes.
• Investment performance and risk management over-
sight.

Source of Risk:
Evolving risks emanating from the below areas:
• Geopolitics and related risks, including conflicts
• Extreme weather / climate conditions
• Evolving regulatory /compliance landscape
• Data privacy risks
• Sustainability risks
• Talent risk
Mitigation:
JHL actively monitors global economic trends, climate-related
risks, and technological disruptions to adapt to its strategies
accordingly.
Additional mitigation actions include:
• Regular monitoring of regulatory landscape and invest-
ment in compliance programs.
• Rollout of data privacy solutions like Data Loss Preven-
tion (DLP).
• Strategy towards attracting and retaining talent were
initiated and ongoing.
